SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PO_LINE_ID FROM UCUBE.XOIF_PUR_KEP_BPA WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY PO_LINE_ID
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'HSDE' AS BUYER ,'KA' AS SITE ,PO_LINE_ID AS QUOTATION_NO ,'1' AS QUOTATION_SEQ ,PO_NUMBER ,STATUS ,DOMESTIC_OR_OVERSEA ,VENDOR_SITE_ID ,VENDOR_NAME ,VENDOR_SITE_CODE ,REVISION_NUM ,ITEM_ID ,ITEM_NUMBER AS BUYER_ITEM_NO ,UOM_CODE ,CURRENCY_CODE ,UNIT_PRICE ,AGENT_NAME ,PREPAYMENT_RATE ,RETAIN_RATE ,PREPAYMENT_AMOUNT ,RETAIN_AMOUNT ,CONTRACT_STANDARD ,INSURANCE_ON_CARGO ,PAYMENT_TERMS ,PAYMENT_METHOD ,FREIGHT_TERMS ,FREIGHT_CARRIER ,INCOTERMS ,COUNTRY_OF_ORIGIN ,CATEGORY_ID ,TO_CHAR(START_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS FROM_DATE ,TO_CHAR(END_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS TO_DATE ,ATTRIBUTE1 ,ATTRIBUTE2 ,ATTRIBUTE3 ,ATTRIBUTE4 ,ATTRIBUTE5 ,ATTRIBUTE6 ,ATTRIBUTE7 ,ATTRIBUTE8 ,ATTRIBUTE9 ,ATTRIBUTE10 ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE ,LAST_UPDATED_BY ,CREATION_DATE ,CREATED_BY ,LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN ,IF_FLAG ,IF_DATE FROM UCUBE.XOIF_PUR_KEP_BPA WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND PO_LINE_ID = $G_RS.PO_LINE_ID$ ORDER BY PO_LINE_ID
UPDATE UCUBE.XOIF_PUR_KEP_BPA SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND PO_LINE_ID = $G_RS.PO_LINE_ID$
